measurement_context.scope: Final C4 application runtime measurement limitations
measurement_context.admission: Native builds, gates and benchmark jobs use shared admission. This is not isolation from every host process or read-only analysis.

coordinator_search.activity: Broad read-only rg file search across sibling worktrees, subsequently terminated
coordinator_search.cpu_affinity: Default process affinity; not separately pinned
coordinator_search.bounds_source: Adjacent coordinator clock observations; exact process timestamps were not logged

measurement_context.other_activity: Lightweight coordinator progress polling and report preparation occurred during collection.
measurement_context.interpretation: CPU affinity does not eliminate shared cache, memory or filesystem effects. Preserve all samples and censors. Review matched ranges and overlap in the final regression screen; do not describe these observations as a completely quiescent host or attribute small differences to one implementation change.

worker_context.clock_basis: UTC filesystem birth/mtime boundaries, not explicit process-clock receipts; exact process timestamps unavailable

analysis.basis: report stdoutlog birth/lastwrite and report.json creation; bootstrap report executed pinned CPU0, no shared admission

compression.basis: raw-windows.tar.gz birth/mtime; archive script set affinity0 before opening archive, no shared admission

archive_verification.basis: verification follows raw-log-index publication and completed before subsequent handoff creation; exact finish not logged, conservative upper bound only

worker_context.limitation: May overlap coordinator application samples. CPU0 affinity does not rule out shared-cache/memory/I/O effects. Preserve all samples and review overlap/noise; no reruns performed. Future substantial compression/verification uses shared admission or waits for application timings.

overlap_resolution: Whole chunk interval only; exact individual launch times unavailable. Possible overlap is conservative, not proof of contention.

relative_timeout_policy.applies_to: checked-ownership uninstrumented warmup and wall invocations; RSS uses the absolute ceiling
relative_timeout_policy.interpretation: A censor exceeded the calibrated wall-time budget; it is not an exact runtime or measured median ratio.
